api.notes: Self-serve console with a documented API. The price list is global, but products are region-specific: NORWAY-1 sells only RTX-A4000; CANADA-1 carries A100 PCIe/NVLink, H100 PCIe/NVLink, H200 SXM5, B200, B300, RTX A6000 and RTX PRO 6000 SE; CANADA-2 and US-1 sell only 8-GPU H100 SXM5, and US-1 also 8-GPU A100 SXM4. Verified 2026-11-09; earlier catalogue rows put every model in Norway, which was wrong.

reliability.capacity_notes: Publishes per-model, per-shape stock counts (console /api/core/stocks). At the 2026-11-08 snapshot: H100 PCIe-NVLink 8 GPUs (one 8x node) and L40 in Canada, A100 SXM4 two 8x nodes in the US, and nothing larger than RTX-A4000 in Norway.
reliability.notes: GPU cloud by NexGen Cloud; data centres in Norway, Canada and the US with one price list. Burst option for non-regulated workloads: not MeitY-empanelled and data leaves India.
